jobs.description:
Position summary:
 

You are responsible for leading the plant mechanical team (Shift Mechanical Engineers, Toolroom, Utility team, Workshop Team, Process Engineers) in all the maintenance and process activities in the plant to ensure smooth operation and maintenance of high speed can making Lines and ancillaries. You will be the key person driving operational excellence programs and size changes in the plant, and also be responsible for all the mechanical safety, lean events, capital projects, energy saving, and EIP.

What are we looking for?
 
 

• 7+ years relevant experience in maintenance in high-speed manufacturing with sound maintenance management practices. 

• Experience in mechanical power presses, hydraulic equipment maintenance, printing press, handling LPG, maintenance of gas-fired ovens, boilers etc. 

• Knowledge of AutoCAD - Mechanical. 

• Experienced in TPM implementation in process industry. Good understanding of other modern lean manufacture technique - SMED, Kaizen 5S, Structured Problem Solving, Six Sigma. 

• Effective communication and problem-solving skills. 

• Ability to prioritize workload based upon the plant requirements and KPI’s. Good planning skills, coordination skill and follow-up skill 

• Comfortable communication in written and spoken English

jobs.occupation: Sales & Marketing Manager - Agricultural Machinery - FR/DU
jobs.description:
Our client is a Belgian family-owned company with over 100 years of experience in the distribution of premium technical equipment for the agricultural sector, the green/landscaping sector, and material handling. It employees +100person, generates +150M€ of annual turnover and aims to strengthen its market position by focusing on leading-edge technology, strong partnerships with dealers, and efficient services in sales, marketing, after-sales, and financing.

Jobomschrijving

As a successful Sales & Marketing Manager - Agricultural Machinery - FR/DU, you will have the following responsibilities:

• Lead the commercial strategy: annual sales plan, margins, product mix

• Animate and guide the sales & marketing team (define priorities, coordinate & coach the team on the field) - you will be responsible of 3 areas sales manager, 3 product managers & 2 persons in the back office 

• Manage pricing strategy and negotiate with key accounts & dealer networks

• Develop business via demo machines, rental, and used equipment

• Be responsible of the company brand by owning all marketing & communication activities & ensuring their consistency: marketing materials, digital channels, campaigns, ... 
• Handle the implementation of a new CRM system
• Strengthen communication with the dealer network: newsletters, events, information sessions

• Oversee events & trade fairs: stand concept, logistics, demos, post-event analysis

• Act as main link between manufacturer & internal teams; track KPIs, market trends, bonuses

As a successful Sales & Marketing Manager - Agricultural Machinery - FR/DU, you will have the following profile:

• +5 years experiences as B2B sales leader with strong commercial development skills & ability to negotiate with wholesalers 
• Experiences with long selling cycle & technical products (agriculture, machinery, industry)
• Previous experience in people management or team coaching 
• Background or strong affinity with the agriculture sector is a plus 
• Solid experience in operational marketing 
• Comfortable in managing projects (CRM, reporting, process optimization)
• Strategical mindset coupled with the willingness to remain operational & available for the teams 
• Personal traits: entrepreneurial mindset, structured, responsible, clear communicator, low ego. 
• Languages: Fluent in French, Dutch & English

If you enjoy working on real robots in real environments and want to see your software operating in 

the field, this role offers the opportunity to make a tangible impact in a fast-growing and innovative 

sector.
 

This is what your job will look like:
 

As a robotic engineer, you will be part of our driven engineering team, where you will work together to 

develop high-quality software solutions. Your tasks will include:
 
 

• Develop, maintain, and improve robotic software using 
ROS2 

• Integrate and optimize 
navigation stacks, SLAM, and sensor fusion 

• Build perception systems using 
Computer Vision (e.g., object detection, visual localization) 

• Design and deploy 
Machine Learning models for robotic perception and autonomous decisionmaking 

• Work hands-on with real robots: system integration, deployment, tuning, and performance 

optimization 

• Contribute to robot control, localization, and path planning 

• Participate in on-site testing and customer deployments across Belgium and the Netherlands  

That's why this job suits you:
 
 

• You are hands-on and have 3-5 years of experience and strong affinity with autonomous navigation, robotics, machine control or industrial automation 

• Thorough knowledge of 
ROS2, C, C++, and Python 

• Solid knowledge in majority of the following fields: 
 

• Sensor fusion for state estimation and localization 

• Control systems for robotics 

• Path planning & Navigation (SLAM) 

• Computer Vision and Machine Learning applied to robotics   

• You’re comfortable working with hardware and in realworld field environments and experience bringing systems from prototype to reliable field deployment 

• You are able to work independently and take responsibility for your work 

• You have a valid EU driving license (for site testing and deployments) 

• You can communicate fluently in English

• You install and assemble sprinkler pipes according to plan.

• You correctly connect sprinkler systems.

• You perform inspections and pressure tests on the systems.

• You often work at heights, following the appropriate safety measures.

• You consult with colleagues on-site to work efficiently together.

• You ensure order, cleanliness, and safety in the workplace.

• Experience in a similar role is what you bring.

• A technical background or education is a must.

• Working at heights doesn’t scare you, and you do it safely.

• You speak and understand English well.

• A driver’s license B is required.

• Motivation and accuracy are what you work with.

This is an exciting opportunity for someone interested in cultural management, European cooperation, project work and the higher music education sector. The ideal candidate is curious, organised and comfortable working in an international environment, with a willingness to learn and take on a wide range of tasks. You will join a small and dynamic team working with a diverse network of institutions and experts across Europe.

 

 
 
As a Project and Membership Intern, you will support the day-to-day work of AEC and contribute to the organisation of events, projects and activities involving its European network. You will assist our expert working groups with organising meetings and preparing publications and reports.  Moreover, you will assist the AEC Office team with the overall management of the office and the various projects. This includes contributing to the financial administration of the projects, of AEC and of the membership. In addition, you will assist the team with projects and activities related to the green shift and sustainability.

Depending on the internship period you will have an opportunity to travel to AEC events to support the AEC team in event-related activities, such as:

• International Relations Coordinators (IRC) Meeting
• AEC Congress
• AEC Pop & Jazz Platform
• AEC European Platform for Artistic Research in Music (EPARM)
Ideal candidates:

• Interest in the higher music education and cultural sector at large
• Interest in the management and coordination aspects of higher music education
• Interest in the Green shift
• Comfortable working with a diverse network across Europe
• Seeking experience in working in a cultural organisation on a European level
Responsibilities:

• Support overall office and project administration, including financial aspects
• Support in coordinating European projects
• Support the coordination and administration of AEC projects
• Support the AEC team in its environmentally friendly actions and initiatives 
• Assist with membership-related administration, including follow-up with member institutions and support with membership fees and documentation
• Assist with the preparation and coordination of meetings with AEC members, the AEC Council, experts and project partners
• Support logistic activities for AEC events
• Assist  the AEC office team in preparing publications and reports,  support basic visual content creation (e.g. Canva)
Requirements:

• Bachelor's degree in Cultural Management or relevant field  
• Possess strong organisational and communication skills
• Willingness to learn
• Comfortable dealing with a wide range of tasks 
• B2 level or higher in written and spoken English (other languages are an asset)
• Good knowledge of MS Office tools, especially Excel and Word
• Ability  to adapt quickly to different situations, feel comfortable dealing with a wide range of tasks and with working in a team
• Proactive, structured, independent and solution-oriented approach to your work 
What AEC offers

• A remuneration of around 1.000 €/ month
• An opportunity to expand or gain a professional network in Brussels
• Opportunity to work with a small, dynamic, and international team in the cultural sector
• An internship contract based on the Belgian Convention d'immersion professionelle 
• A hands-on experience in a supportive learning environment

We are currently hiring an Operations Shift Manager to reinforce and support our Operations teams.

Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is a subsidiary of Safran Aircraft Engines, based at Brussels Airport (Zaventem & Steenokkerzeel, Belgium), specialized in the inspection, maintenance and repair (MRO) of the advanced LEAP jet engines that power the latest generation of the Airbus A320NEO & Boeing B737MAX narrow body families. The company is a key player in the integrated CFM international MRO network. With more than 75 years of experience, and up to 20 international Part 145 certifications (EASA/ FAA/ CAAC/ …), 
Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is recognized as a worldwide center of expertise in the air transport industry. More than a 100 airlines, lessors, private aircraft operators and MRO partners have entrusted their engines to our company. We employ over 500 highly skilled, passionate and enthusiastic employees.

Your job:
Reporting to the Operations Manager, you lead assembly, disassembly, and inspection teams within a high-performance aerospace environment. You ensure daily workshop operations run safely, efficiently, and in full compliance with customer, aviation, and Safran standards. Your focus is on delivering engine shop visit milestones on time while maintaining the highest levels of quality and safety.

Main tasks and responsibilities:
Operations & Planning

• Translate weekly production plans into daily priorities
• Manage shop floor activities to achieve on-time delivery
• Allocate workforce and resources efficiently
• Ensure smooth shift handovers
• Coordinate with planning and support teams
Team Leadership

• Lead and coach Team Leaders, Mechanics and Inspectors
• Drive training and performance improvement
• Support recruitment and development
• Foster teamwork and accountability
Safety & Quality

• Ensure compliance with HSE standards
• Promote a strong safety culture
• Ensure adherence to aviation quality standards
• Participate in audits and corrective actions
Performance & Continuous Improvement

• Monitor performance using QRQC
• Identify and implement improvements
• Manage quality deviations
• Optimize processes and operations

Your profile:

• You are both a leader and a team player, able to inspire while collaborating with others.
• You bring expertise, holding a Bachelor or Master in Electromechanics with 3-5 years of relevant experience in an industrial environment.
• You have proven strong people management skills and the drive to take on new challenges with confidence.
• You are analytical and resilient, thriving under pressure and keeping a sharp focus on deadlines.
• You are communicative and fluent in Dutch, French and English.
• You are flexible, ready to work in shifts (Monday to Friday: 6am-2pm, 2pm-10pm).

Candidates must be legally authorized to work in Belgium, holding either an EU passport or a valid work & residence permit. Please note that we do not provide assistance with visa or permit applications.

Bedrijfsomschrijving 

This company (re)packs and stores frozen and refrigerated food products for numerous European companies. They do this for each customer. By 2027, the company aims to have 300+ employees working on 25 000 unique packaging assignments. Working in this company means working in a respectful environment, where a great bond between employees and dedication to work go hand in hand.

As an operator, you will be responsible for 1 of 2 automatic packaging lines.

 
• 
You carry out checks on the food products that are introduced.

 
• 
You also set various parameters so that the right product ends up in the right packaging.

 
• 
Furthermore, you have to monitor the smooth operation of your packaging line.

 
• 
In case of technical failures, you are the first person who tries to solve this. For major malfunctions, you coordinate with the person in charge.

 
• 
The checks on the finished product are also done by you.

 
• 
All this in a team with a co-operator and 2 forklift drivers.

Read on quickly below and find out if you qualify:

 
• 
You have experience in setting up machines (it is a vertical packaging machine).

 
• 
You have a good technical knowledge.

 
• 
You speak good English and Dutch

 
• 
Experience as a forklift operator or forklift certificate is a plus.

 
• 
You highly value safety.

Together with functional experts, scrum masters, UX designers and other developers, you

jobs.occupation: Kitchen Help Industrial Kitchen - Aalter - 2 Shifts
jobs.description:
Vol-au-vent, tomato soup with meatballs, or a perfectly cooked roast beef: you’ll be licking your fingers and thumbs. And in this role, you’ll make sure others can do the same. In our kitchen, we create dishes that would make grandmothers jealous—but on an industrial scale, in large quantities.
 

We’re looking for a Kitchen Help for a food company in Aalter!
 

Hygiene is crucial for a kitchen staff member. That’s why you’ll ensure every day that your work methods and the final products meet all standards.
 

You’ll also follow safety regulations to the letter. You’ll do everything in your power to guarantee both quality and safety. 
 

 

Who are you?

• You have experience as a cook in a commercial or industrial kitchen. Do you also have experience in a production environment? If so, that’s a plus.
• You are able and willing to work in a rotating two-shift system.
• The early shift starts at 4:30 a.m. and runs until 12:30 p.m.
• The late shift starts at 12:45 p.m. and runs until 8:00 p.m.
• You know how to operate machinery or are willing to undergo training for this.
• Physical work doesn’t deter you, and you’re hands-on.
• You work with great precision and are flexible and able to handle stress.
• You’re a good communicator, enjoy variety, and like working in a team.
• You speak Dutch or English well.
